turns.speaker: AGT
turns.text: Namaste sir, main aapka loan EMI helpline se bol raha hoon, bataiye kya madad chahiye hai?

turns.speaker: CUS
turns.text: Mera EMI toh clear lag raha tha par aap log ab credit score Shield aur beneficiary Priority kyun check karwa rahe ho?

turns.speaker: AGT
turns.text: Haan sir, kabhi kabhi NirSahay ya ZepAamdani ke wajah se thoda processing delay ho jaata hai, bas verification chal raha hai.

turns.speaker: CUS
turns.text: Arre samajh gaya, lekin main toh abhi VPA Priority ya BHIM Pro se payment karne wala tha, yeh kab clear hoga?

turns.speaker: AGT
turns.text: Ji sir, aapka request ZepBazaar aur RuvSugam par raise kar diya hai, kal tak aapko update mil jayega.
